about.title: 📈 What is Matplotlib?
about.description: Matplotlib is Python's foundational plotting library. It provides complete control over every aspect of your charts - from basic line plots to complex multi-panel visualizations. Unlike Bokeh (which focuses on interactivity), Matplotlib excels at creating publication-quality static figures with precise customization.

items.bar: Horizontal Bar Charts: Great for comparing categories when labels are long
items.pie: Pie Charts: Show proportions of a whole (regional distribution)
items.scatter: Scatter Plots: Reveal correlations between two variables
items.log: Log Scales: Handle data spanning multiple orders of magnitude
items.colorMap: Color Maps: Use color intensity to represent data values (heatmap effect)

items.deathTolls: The Americas and Europe regions had the highest death tolls
items.correlation: Larger outbreaks don't always correlate linearly with deaths (different healthcare responses)
items.cfr: Case Fatality Rate varies significantly based on healthcare capacity, testing rates, and demographics
items.testing: Countries with robust testing may show lower CFR due to detecting more mild cases

items.pandas: Pandas Operations: nlargest(), groupby(), filtering with boolean indexing
items.color: Color Mapping: plt.cm.Reds, plt.cm.Set3, plt.cm.YlOrRd for visual hierarchy
items.log: Log Scales: set_xscale('log') for handling wide value ranges
items.caching: Data Caching: All 4 charts share the same loaded CSV (efficient!)
items.clientSide: Client-Side Processing: All analysis happens in your browser via WebAssembly
